name: GlitchPad
description: Glitch²-style XY pad for NTS-3. Keeps a tempo-synced AUDIO IN buffer (get_raw_input on firmware 1.4+) and locks one of four scenes from the touch start region, like Passort. Top-left = Retrigger. Top-right = Reverse. Bottom-left = Shuffle. Bottom-right = Gate. While held, Y sets slice / rate (bottom = long, top = short). Depth = wet. Untouched = bypass. DECAY fades repeats / gate edges. SYNC: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE. HOLD: GATE or LATCH.

params.name: MIX
params.detail: Dry/wet while the effect is engaged

params.name: DECAY
params.detail: Retrigger fade, shuffle fade, and gate edge smoothing

params.name: SYNC
params.detail: Time grid: EVEN, TRIP, DOT, FREE

params.name: HOLD
params.detail: GATE = hold to glitch. LATCH = stays after release; switch back to GATE to stop
